sections.content: dolgozik ('to work') belongs to a special class called -ik verbs. In the 1st person singular, -ik verbs take -om/-em/-öm instead of the regular -ok/-ek/-ök: dolgozom, not dolgozok.

dolgozom is the shape to memorise as a model: any time you meet another -ik verb (eszik, alszik, lakik...), reach for -om/-em/-öm in the 'I' form, not the -ok/-ek/-ök you'd expect from a regular verb.
